translations.ui.d398ae18ddb4: Irema sesiyo y'uruhande rwa seriveri; ntiyemeza ko hari telefoni ya PSTN kugeza ubwo utanga serivisi ya telekom yohereza ibyabaye kuri webhook yizewe.
translations.ui.07ddb7f340fd: IVR: Kanda 1 ku kibazo, 2 ku gahunda, 3 ku muhagararizi w'ubufasha.
translations.ui.8ef964729e07: Ifata telefoni ya kera cyane mu murongo hanyuma ikayishyira ku muhagararizi mwiza uboneka (guhura n'ubumenyi, hanyuma gutegereza cyane). Icyemezo cyo gushyira gusa — si guhuza telefoni nyayo.
translations.ui.9077c50d8036: ID ya sesiyo y'amajwi yo gukura
translations.ui.43db61570404: Ikarita ikoresha Leaflet n'amakuru y'ubuzima /v1/gis/fleet. UI ntabwo irema utudomo tw'imodoka.
translations.ui.17a1e3ec5d4a: Kamera na browser bifata icyemezo mu karere. Amakuru y'ahantu akomoka kuri GPS, hanyuma icyemezo gishobora koherezwa kuri seriveri hakoreshejwe itike yemewe.
translations.ui.06fa943be019: Gutanga ubwoko ni byemewe: byihuse bya SLA + guhura n'ubumenyi + intera + umurimo. Seriveri ni ububasha bwo gushyira.
translations.ui.f1a80e3e8395: Iyi ntabwo ari ecran y'ubwiza. Urutonde rwo hepfo rwubatswe kuva kuri referansi ya HTML yashyizweho kandi rugabanya ubushobozi bose hashingiwe ku cyemezo cyo gushyira mu bikorwa mu bubiko. Izina ry'ikintu ntabwo risobanura ko ikintu cyuzuye.
translations.ui.1e22c22f5622: Gusoma imibare gusa muri PostgreSQL. Nta AI CEO yigenga, nta gushyira mu bikorwa imari yigenga, kandi nta bisubizo by'ibinyoma byerekanywe nk'ukuri.
